about.title: About
about.seoDesc: Il Bel Paese: the first mapping, promotion and research platform that legitimises Italy's independent artistic realities.
about.p1_html: Il Bel Paese is the first mapping, promotion and research platform that legitimises independent Italian artistic and project-based realities.
about.p2_html: Through a dynamic showcase and a historical archive, the project systematises these experiences to foster networks and narrow the gap between the independent scene and the institutional system.
about.p3: We believe independent realities — physical spaces, those without a venue, and those no longer in existence — are a collective cultural heritage that deserves recognition, memory and tools to dialogue with the rest of the art system.
about.missionDesc: To legitimise, network and give voice to Italy's independent artistic realities through mapping, promotion and research.
about.visionDesc: An ecosystem where the independent scene and the institutional world meet as equals, recognising one another as part of the same cultural landscape.

what.title: What We
what.intro_html: Il Bel Paese is the first mapping, promotion and research platform that brings together and tells the story of Italy's independent scene.
what.intro_html2: Through a dynamic showcase and a historical archive, the project systematises these experiences to foster networks and narrow the gap between the independent scene and the institutional system.
what.seoDesc: Mapping, promotion and research: the three pillars through which Il Bel Paese tells the story of Italy's independent art scene.

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.desc_html: We identify and categorise Italy's independent artistic realities into three families: Spaces (with a physical venue), Spaces without a space (itinerant, digital, nomadic) and Spaces that were (historical archive of concluded experiences).

promotion.title: Promotion
promotion.desc: We give visibility to mapped realities through a dynamic showcase, an academically-minded editorial line and oral interviews produced in collaboration with equally independent radio stations and podcast platforms.

research.title: Research
research.desc: We carry out research, gather data and produce content for a counter-narrative to the mainstream framing that so often shapes the independent scene.

whyBullets: For a critical counter-narrative of the independent scene.
To spark new connections and unexpected collaborations.
For the legitimacy that is still missing.
what.ctaText: If you represent an independent artistic reality, are a researcher or an institutional partner, you can write to us here.
